citations.excerpt: The council did in fact meet on 11 November, and its sessions were prolonged until the end of the month.

facts.value: Council assembled by Pope Innocent III that issued seventy decrees on doctrine and discipline.

citations.excerpt: From the commencement of his reign Innocent III had purposed to assemble an ecumenical council
the pope presented to the council seventy decrees or canons, already formulated, on the most important points of dogmatic and moral theology .
